spec.description:
Higgins Polyester Thermal & Acoustic Batts are premium 100%
polyester insulation batts manufactured in Queensland, Australia, for
residential and commercial ceilings, walls, and mid-floors. Formed from
thermally bonded polyester fibers containing up to 85% recycled PET bottles,
they are completely free of chemical binders, resins, and formaldehyde. Safe and
non-irritant to handle without protective gear, they provide permanent thermal
resistance and acoustic sound dampening that will not slump, pack down, or
deteriorate over time.
features:
Manufactured from 100% polyester fiber
containing up to 85% recycled PET

Completely itch-free, non-toxic,
non-allergenic, and safe to touch without PPE

Zero chemical binders, resins,
formaldehyde, or volatile organic compounds (VOCs)

Non-combustible fire
performance with zero ODP and zero ozone emissions

Outstanding acoustic
absorption reducing airborne sound transfer between rooms

Fibers will not
slump, break down, or crumble over the lifetime of the building

Naturally
resistant to moisture, vermin, insects, and mold growth

Pre-cut to
standard 430mm and 580mm widths to suit Australian timber and steel framing
Tested and certified to Australian Standard AS/NZS 4859.1

install:
Isolate electrical power at the main switchboard before
entering ceiling or working in wall cavities

Select batt width (430mm
or 580mm) to suit timber or steel framing spacing (450mm or 600mm)

In
ceilings, lay batts flat between ceiling joists ensuring complete coverage over
plasterboard without gaps

In walls, friction-fit batts firmly between studs
ensuring batts butt tightly against top and bottom plates

Do not compress
batts into cavities narrower than nominal thickness

Maintain minimum 50mm
clearance around non-IC rated recessed downlights and heat sources as per
AS 3999

At roof eaves, ensure insulation does not block natural roof
ventilation pathways

Tear batts across the width by hand or cut with a sharp
serrated knife if custom sizing is needed
selection_checklist:
Confirm
application (ceiling space vs external or internal wall)

Select target
R-value (e.g. R2.0/R2.5 in walls, R3.5 to R5.0 in ceilings) for NCC climate zone
compliance

Measure framing spacing (450mm centers require 430mm batts; 600mm
centers require 580mm batts)

Check cavity depth (75mm for 70mm studs; 90mm
for 90mm studs)

Verify preference for itch-free, zero-formaldehyde polyester
insulation
limitations:
Do not compress batts
significantly as this degrades thermal R-value

Not designed for exposed
decorative finishes; must be enclosed behind plasterboard or internal linings
Maintain required clearances around non-IC rated electrical downlights

use_cases:
Insulating residential ceiling spaces with
itch-free, asthma-safe polyester batts to lower energy bills

Thermal and
acoustic insulation in external timber-stud and steel-stud walls behind
plasterboard

Internal wall sound dampening between bedrooms, bathrooms, and
home theater rooms
not_for:
Underfloor crawl spaces with wind exposure
without support
Direct external cladding exposure without building wrap
retrieval.rag_summary:
Higgins Polyester Thermal &
Acoustic Batts are non-itchy, Australian-made insulation batts manufactured
from 100% polyester fiber containing up to 85% recycled PET plastic bottles.
Available in ceiling ratings from R2.5 to R5.0 and wall ratings from R1.5 to
R2.5 (widths 430mm and 580mm), they deliver durable thermal resistance and sound
absorption without slumping or degrading over time. Completely free of chemical
binders, resins, and formaldehyde, they are non-allergenic, Sensitive Choice
friendly, and backed by a 50-year manufacturer warranty.
